notes.title: Remaking The Rift!
notes.notes:
[b]REMAKING THE RIFT[/b]


Hello! My latest game "In Between" has just hit steam. The next few weeks will be dedicated to managing bugs and making updates to that. However, over the next few months I will be completely rebuilding "The Rift" from the ground up. There are many bugs and is overall not up to my standards. I've grown a lot as a developer since then and would rather not have work on the steam store that isn't representative to my skills. This new version will of course be free (to anyone who already owns the game) and will come as just a normal game update. No DLC or anything of the sort.

Thanks!
